subject: benji-tokenized-funds

benji.name: BENJI (Franklin Templeton OnChain US Government Money Fund)
benji.chain: Stellar, Polygon, Ethereum, Base, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism
benji.note: First SEC-registered tokenized money fund. Shares are tokens. NAV updates on-chain.

measurement_opportunity: Each tokenized fund has: issuer, custodian, auditor, NAV frequency, chain deployment, reserve composition. All measurable. Nobody publishes signed cross-fund comparison cards.
honest_sentence: BENJI ($700M+) is the original tokenized fund. BlackRock BUIDL ($2.76B), Circle USYC ($2.60B), Ondo USDY ($2.22B) follow the same pattern. All have on-chain attestable state. Nobody measures them side-by-side.
